• ABCOTS (SAST): A B Cotspin India Limited has notified shareholders without registered email addresses about its upcoming 29th Annual General Meeting on September 29, 2026, and provided the web-link to access the FY 2025-26 Annual Report, fulfilling SEBI regulatory requirements. A key takeaway is the critical reminder for shareholders holding physical securities to update their KYC details, as incomplete information will restrict all payments (e.g., dividends) to electronic mode only, a mandate effective since April 1, 2024. This serves as an important operational warning for affected shareholders to prevent payment disruptions. └ 📄 Source

• ABINFRA (Dividend): A B Infrabuild Limited reported robust financial performance for FY2026, highlighting strong project execution and a healthy order book within India's growing infrastructure sector. However, the company proposes significantly increasing its borrowing capacity and limits for inter-corporate loans/investments, both up to INR 1,000 Crores and exceeding statutory thresholds, which represents a material expansion of its financial flexibility and potential leverage. A key red flag is the notably low 0.60% dividend declaration despite claims of improved profitability, contrasting with these substantial financial flexibility requests that suggest a high-leverage growth strategy. └ 📄 Source

• AGRITECH (Results): Agri-Tech (India) Limited reported a reduced net loss of Rs. 2.85 lakhs for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, demonstrating improved profitability compared to the previous year and quarter, though the company remains in a loss-making position. A significant red flag is the auditor's qualified opinion, highlighting the company's non-compliance with Section 186 of the Companies Act and Ind AS 109 for not charging interest on inter-corporate loans to a related party. This unquantified omission potentially misstates financial assets and profitability, raising concerns about related-party transactions and the true financial health of the company. └ 📄 Source

• ARMANFIN (Dividend): This document from Arman Financial Services Limited announces the 34th Annual General Meeting and the availability of the FY2025-26 Annual Report. Crucially, it mandates shareholders to update their PAN, KYC details, and nominations for physical securities as per recent SEBI regulations, providing links and contact information for compliance. A key takeaway is the significant issue of unclaimed dividends, with amounts for FY2017-18 and earlier already transferred to the IEPF, prompting shareholders to claim the remaining FY2018-19 dividend promptly. └ 📄 Source

• ARMANFIN (Regulatory Risk): Arman Financial Services Limited's FY2025-26 Business Responsibility & Sustainability Report highlights its core focus on MSME and two-wheeler finance in rural/semi-rural India. However, the report reveals critical red flags including an alarmingly high permanent employee turnover rate of 63.02% and a significant surge in customer complaints from 9 to 50, indicating potential operational inefficiencies and reputational risks. Additionally, a notable lack of gender diversity among Key Management Personnel and a subsidiary that does not participate in the parent's business responsibility initiatives are observed. └ 📄 Source

• ASAHISONG (Dividend): Asahi Songwon Colors Limited has notified shareholders and exchanges about its 36th Annual General Meeting (AGM) scheduled virtually for September 30, 2026, along with the online availability of the FY 2025-26 Annual Report. The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 1.50 per equity share, pending AGM approval, impacting shareholders who must ensure KYC compliance and updated email addresses for electronic dividend receipt. This standard regulatory disclosure details routine corporate actions and encourages digital shareholder engagement, with no immediate red flags identified. └ 📄 Source

• ASAHISONG (Dividend): Executive Summary: Asahi Songwon Colors Limited has announced a final dividend of Rs. 1.50 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
